status: Vehicle and crew filled from public sources, re-cited after the October 2026 research review (docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md). Radar and missile sections stay empty: outcomes come from the gameplay-level model (data/gameplay/osa_ak.json), not from per-system performance data. Tier-5 citations (gs, apa) are kept only where no better source exists yet (roadmap 6.8).

crew.notes: An officer; receives target designations from the battery PU-12 by radio and gives orders. NVA: the platoon leader commands one of the platoon's vehicles. Front cab, beside the driver (zbiam_2019).

Career NCO / sergeant, deputy crew chief: launch console (key, launch-ready lamp, missile selector, voltmeter), elevation wheel, TV monitor, elevation display. SAM Simulator: Firing Officer / elevation operator. wrk: guidance operator.
Search radar scope, IFF interrogation, puts the target under the azimuth and range marks with handwheels. SAM Simulator: azimuth operator. wrk: search operator.
Range display and range tracking; captures with ТСЦ. SAM Simulator: Range Officer. wrk: range operator.
Crew of five in the NVA (flak11), Soviet (wrk), Polish and ru_wiki sources for the Osa-AK. Four in Russian service after the Osa-AKM1 upgrade ('crew reduced by one', nvo_2015; ilya_prosto).

max_road_speed_mps.source: flak11 (9K33-0: 70 km/h road, 15 km/h terrain), ru_wiki (70 km/h, 9A33B)
max_road_speed_mps.notes: Sources disagree: 60 km/h on roads for the complex's vehicles (wrk), 70 km/h (flak11, ru_wiki; flak11 adds 'in practice much faster'), 80 km/h (nuou; wrk for the chassis). 70 km/h used.

deploy_time_s.source: nvo_2015 (march to combat position no more than 4 min), wrk (within 4 min including the GTA start)
deploy_time_s.notes: Russian norms quoted as 3 min for the Osa-AKM. Different measure: a cold start (switch-on cycle 3.8 min + function check 3.0 min = 6.8 min, flak11 9K33-0), which SAM3D does not model yet (roadmap 6.2).

stow_time_s.source: ru_wiki (deployment and stowing not more than 5 min)
stow_time_s.notes: No tier-1 source found yet for stowing alone.

search_on_the_move_max_speed_mps.source: wrk (search possible at up to 80 km/h)

engages_from.source: nvo_2015 ('с места или короткой остановки'), wrk, flak11

power.value: 9И120 gas-turbine unit (on the move and at a halt); engine power take-off generator (at a halt only)
power.notes: 9И120 = 9И56-3 gas-turbine engine + С-75 generator, about 50 kW; the take-off generator about 35 kW. Fuel (ePap): ~300 l tank, turbine ~75 l/h stationary and ~100 l/h moving, take-off generator ~25 l/h; half the tank is kept for driving. '9I210' in apa and flak11 is probably a confusion with the 9В210 maintenance vehicle.

validation_scenarios.description: Training-range shoot (Ashuluk, Kapustin Yar, Ustka, NAMFI style): drones or P-15 targets, two-missile salvo, a kill near maximum range (10.3 km reported at Kapustin Yar, 2013)
Bekaa, 24 July 1982: Syrian SA-8 shoots down an Israeli F-4E while other vehicles are attacked
Cuito Cuanavale, 1987–88: FAPLA Osa-AK units against SAAF aircraft and RPVs; Mirage F1AZ, 20 February 1988
